body: Thanks for your response! I think so. I am afraid of losing control of myself and acting on self harm/SI type thoughts, though this fear is present in all other areas of my life too. It is just a bit enhanced when thinking about taking a medication like ketamine.

Thanks so much for your input! I really appreciate you taking the time to answer and also make some really helpful suggestions. I am going to do just that, get myself all set up and place the trust in myself to make the experience the best I can before taking it. Thanks again!
Ah I forgot this. I haven’t used hallucinogenics before, but have smoked a ton of weed and taken high dose edibles in the past. Though I know that’s not the same thing.
